description: This source file defines enums, structs, and functions related to remote gateway probing and authentication handling within an OpenClaw application. It manages connection states, authentication issues, and conducts network checks such as WebSocket URL validation and SSH command execution.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously probes the remote gateway to determine its state, returning a result indicating readiness, authentication issues, or failure.

methods.name: isValidWsUrl
methods.description: Validates whether a given WebSocket URL is properly formatted and accepted by normalization rules.

methods.name: sshCheckCommand
methods.description: Constructs an SSH command for checking connectivity to a remote target with specific options.

methods.name: formatSSHFailure
methods.description: Formats a detailed error message based on the SSH response payload and error details.
